events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Battlefield Strain

options.text: Send him to a temple for care.

events.text: After the horrors of the recent skirmish, [character] appears to be suffering from a strange mental affliction. He will not speak, eat, or rise from his bed to confer with officers. Our soldiers are beginning to worry about their leader.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Elephant Formations

tip: As governor: +1 Level for new Elephant units

events.text: Riding atop of your [unit] has built an affinity with the giant creatures. In between encounters, you have been learning as much as possible about how the animals are trained and reared. As you ride to battle once again, you imagine the tactics and formations that a charge of expertly trained elephants could allow.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fog of War

options.text: Mistakes can happen in the fog of war

events.text: In the confusion of battle, our soldiers accidentally charge at their fellow [rival] troops, slaying many before realizing their mistake. General [character] is among those injured in the chaos.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Like Heroes of Old

options.text: Give glory to the gods who guided you to victory.
Take hold of yourself, such visions are likely some form of battle madness.

events.text: As you charge into battle, it feels as if you are filled with the strength of. In the midst of the fighting it is as if the gods have lifted a veil from your eyes and you can see the gods fighting alongside the troops of either side, guiding their hands in the killing. You collapse after the battle, but the troops are already talking about how you fought like and the other heroes of old.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Shattered Sword
events.text: In the heat of battle, your treasured sword shatters, breaking into a thousand brilliant slivers. Your soldiers worry that this is a bad omen, a sign of troubles to come.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Defector

options.text: Ignore [character] warnings and accept the [religion] defector.

events.text: In the midst of the fighting, [character] was sought out by the [rival] officer [character]. Rather than fighting, the warrior threw down his at the general's feet and allowed himself to be taken into custody. Questioning the officer after the battle, [character] reports that he claims to be a [religion] defector, choosing to fight with the nation that follows his faith rather than his homeland. [character] doubts the story, but refers to your decision about what to do with the turn-coat.
